201.description: The stock moved; the body is the relocation record.

reason.description: Why the stock moved. REPLENISHMENT (ADR 0041) appears only on relocations made by a completed REPLENISH task; it is never accepted on the request.

sourceRef.description: The caller's correlation; empty when none was given.

destinationStockUnitId.description: The StockUnit created in toBin (site custody = siteCode).

items.description: One source StockUnit's contribution to the move.
items.title: RelocationLeg

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an empty siteCode, sku, fromBin or toBin, or the Idempotency-Key header absent (ADR 0018).
